about: 303 fragments of Halper SM, Hossain A, Salis HM, ACS Synth Biol 2020;9(7):1563-1571 (Supplementary Data 1, github.com/hsalis/SalisLabCode). features: the nine the forest reads; from the authors' published table, except repeat_9_metric (not in the table: from the authors' RepeatFinder/seq_eval code) and the one row marked in 'origin' whose table values do not belong to its own sequence (authors' code). total_GC is exact; richest_hairpin has the table's 9 decimals. p1/outcome: the authors' trained forest evaluated by scikit-learn's own tree code. status: the paper's label.
